description: Catalog of every Rank capability and the surfaces that document it. The CLI, the MCP server, and the Convex HTTP routes are implemented separately and checked against this file; `pnpm check:surfaces` verifies names, routes, and manifest references by source inspection, not runtime parity. A shared entry means the same subject on each surface, not identical behavior — see per-surface scope notes. A surface marked planned is declared intent with a recorded reason, not an implementation.

capabilities.title: Environment preflight
capabilities.summary: Resolve every environment variable Rank reads and report what is missing per pipeline stage. Scope differs by surface: the CLI reads the linked deployment unless --local is passed, the MCP tool reads local sources only, and the HTTP route reports deployment presence through a Convex query.

capabilities.title: Describe Rank environment
capabilities.summary: List every environment variable Rank reads, who consumes it, and what breaks without it.

capabilities.title: List Rank capabilities
capabilities.summary: List every capability and the CLI command, MCP tool, and HTTP route that expose it.

capabilities.title: Evaluate one prospect
capabilities.summary: Judge one prospect against the brand and save a human-reviewable result. Evaluate and persist only: no outreach, no cross-owner reads. HTTP is deferred: no external client needs it and no authenticated public-route pattern exists yet.

http.reason: Deferred: no external HTTP client needs this operation and no authenticated public-route pattern exists. Revisit when a non-Convex client requires it.

capabilities.title: Sign in and store the session
capabilities.summary: Sign in via the web app (PKCE browser flow over a one-shot loopback exchange) or store a pasted Clerk token, validate it against the linked deployment, then persist it in the gitignored .rank/ home. Never writes to .env.local or the process environment, and never prints the token in full.

mcp.reason: Deferred: browser sign-in and token storage are a local operator action bound to the .rank/ home; a stdio tool can open no browser and holding secrets in MCP arguments would defeat the home. Revisit if an agent flow needs token injection without a terminal.

http.reason: Deferred: the browser half of the exchange is a web-app route (apps/web /cli), not a Convex HTTP API. A public route trading Clerk session tokens would weaken the credential's locality.

capabilities.title: Sign out the stored session
capabilities.summary: Remove the .rank/sessions.json entry for a deployment (the sole stored one when unambiguous), optionally deleting the now-empty file. No network call: the token is local state, and the deployment needs no notification because Clerk sessions remain revocable in the web app.

mcp.reason: Deferred: same operator-local action as auth.login; see that entry's reason.

http.reason: Deferred: same as auth.login; deleting local state is not a public API concern.

capabilities.title: Show and verify the stored session
capabilities.summary: Report which deployment the .rank/ session is bound to, when it was logged in, and a masked token, then prove the token still works by calling the owner-gated listProspectEvaluationRuns query. Exit 1 (and a clear re-login hint) when the deployment rejects the stored token.

mcp.reason: Deferred: diagnostics belong to rank_doctor, which already resolves .rank/ as an env source. Revisit if per-session status is needed without the full preflight.

http.reason: Deferred: session status is local state; rank/status already covers deployment visibility.
